verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's marketing and docs say it registers you in the jurisdictions that require it. Its API includes registration records you can create and track, with filings linked to each registration. Evidence of the in-product, done-for-you registration workflow is mostly marketing-level, and the pack says nothing about local (as opposed to state) registrations, pricing, or registration-application status. Missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, explicit local registration support, status tracking of the vendor-filed registration application, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
